u0: Initial progress: no key-held step has been registered yet, and the agent is not carrying the yellow key. Next objective: locate and pick up the yellow key so that the first has_key observation advances to u1; until then, the machine remains in u0.
u1: One key-held step has been completed. Next objective: keep the yellow key in hand through one more step; another has_key observation advances to final u2. If the key was dropped or lost after the first hold, that progress is retained, so the agent must reacquire it and hold it again; otherwise it should simply continue carrying it.
u2: Final absorbing state: the yellow key has been held on at least two qualifying steps, so the key-holding task is complete. No further key-holding objective remains, and later actions or losing the key do not change the RM state; if the environment episode continues, only separate DoorKey objectives such as opening the door and reaching the goal remain.
